name: integral
title: Integration divides each coefficient by its new degree.

origin.description: Integration divides each coefficient by its new degree.
origin.details: The indefinite integral and the definite integral from 0 to 1.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.

translation.description: Integration divides each coefficient by its new degree.
translation.details: The indefinite integral and the definite integral from 0 to 1.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from polynom import polynomial, integral, as_character

def one():
    p = polynomial([1, 2, 1])
    return as_character(integral(p)) + " " + f"{integral(p, [0, 1])[0]:.17g}"
print(one())
